mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_popular_cache ( period_type, period_date, locale, query, search_count, rank, refreshed_at ) VALUES ( #{periodType}, #{periodDate}, #{locale}, #{query}, #{searchCount}, #{rank}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (period_type, period_date, locale, query) DO UPDATE SET search_count = EXCLUDED.search_count, rank = EXCLUDED.rank, refreshed_at = NOW()
